not_visible.G: the lesson page layout, links, close-ups, construction diagrams, transfer outline and the lessons site (tiles, versions, history); all 20 step pictures, the photo and the finish are present and in order
not_visible.H: how the run went (renders, checks, diagram coloring); no placeholders, internal ids or tool notes were found in the words

summary: Most faults are step pictures that change things the words never ask for: step 7 repaints the whole snow field, and steps 13, 16 and 19 quietly recut shapes that were blocked in badly two steps earlier (bracket slab, rail-cap slabs, lantern blob), so the earlier block-ins are the real outline faults. A flat, markless snow base (step 4) and a hard seam in the far snow (steps 7 to 16) recur across many steps. The words are mostly sound, but step 20 names deep blue for bars the picture paints brass, and steps 7 and 16 put their area or marks in the wrong place.
